title: High yield, capped gains: Mechanics, trade-offs, and practical diagnostics for covered-call ETFs: replication package
description: Replication package for the article published in The Journal of Beta Investment Strategies, 17(2), Summer 2026, pp. 110-123. Code and data that reproduce the article's payoff illustrations (NAV profile of a covered-call position at expiration; long call, short call and covered-call profit diagrams) and its two fund tables: trailing distribution yield and one-year NAV total return of four US-listed and four UCITS covered-call ETFs. The article text is copyright PMR and is not included. Third-party input data remain the property of their sources and are included for replication only; the code is MIT-licensed.
